exposure: TP regimen (paclitaxel 135~175 mg/m2 plus cisplatin 70~75 mg/m2)
TC regimen (paclitaxel 135~175 mg/m2 plus carboplatin AUC=5)
outcome: Accuracy of MRI in staging cervical cancer
Apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) changes before and after chemotherapy
cohort: 16 patients with histopathologically confirmed cervical cancer during pregnancy
finding: MRI was helpful in staging cervical cancer during pregnancy, allowing for conservative treatment in early-stage cases and monitoring of chemotherapy response in advanced-stage cases, with ADC showing potential as a marker of chemotherapy efficacy.
mod_finding: Patients with stage IA cervical cancer confirmed by MRI can choose conservative treatment and continue the pregnancy until term birth.
